The '''Teth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located at the outer border of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a large [[Battle of Teth/Legends|battle]] took place between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] in the system on the planet of the [[Teth/Legends|same name]].
